title: 埃吉納深水油田
summary: 埃吉納公開資料將深水條件與大型 FPSO 連結；課程重點是船體、海底連接及裝配驗證的不同尺度。本課依序分析大型船體重量帳、長海底液相路徑、多地模組裝配、海洋接口減薄趨勢、整合驗證資料鏈，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Egina’s public description links deepwater conditions with a large FPSO; teaching distinguishes hull, subsea connection and assembly scales. The course analyses large-hull weight account, long subsea liquid routes, multi-location module assembly, thinning trends at marine interfaces, integrated verification data chain, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 大型船體重量帳、長海底液相路徑、多地模組裝配
v31FocusEn: Large-hull weight account; Long subsea liquid routes; Multi-location module assembly

quiz.question: 關於「大型船體重量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Large-hull weight account" is correct?
options: 漂浮平衡時排開海水的重量必須等於系統重量，水面面積控制新增重量造成的吃水變化。
只要總排水量足夠，模組放在任何位置都一樣。
流速增加一成時，摩擦壓降也只增加一成。
optionsEn: At floating equilibrium the weight of displaced seawater equals system weight, while waterplane area controls draft change from added mass.
Adequate total displacement means modules can be placed anywhere.
A ten-percent velocity rise increases friction loss by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 漂浮平衡時排開海水的重量必須等於系統重量，水面面積控制新增重量造成的吃水變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At floating equilibrium the weight of displaced seawater equals system weight, while waterplane area controls draft change from added mass. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Large-hull weight account” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Egina deepwater field”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「大型船體重量帳」。埃吉納公開資料將深水條件與大型 FPSO 連結；課程重點是船體、海底連接及裝配驗證的不同尺度。在「埃吉納深水油田」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。漂浮平衡時排開海水的重量必須等於系統重量，水面面積控制新增重量造成的吃水變化。這個一階模型把水線面積視為常數，不計船形曲率、自由液面和縱傾，因此適合做重量帳的敏感度而非完整穩度計算。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Large-hull weight account”. Egina’s public description links deepwater conditions with a large FPSO; teaching distinguishes hull, subsea connection and assembly scales. In the teaching model for Egina deepwater field, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. At floating equilibrium the weight of displaced seawater equals system weight, while waterplane area controls draft change from added mass. This first-order model holds waterplane area constant and excludes hull curvature, free-surface effects and trim. It supports weight-account sensitivity rather than a complete stability assessment. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「大型船體重量帳」的模型 Δdraft = ΔM/(rho A)，「大型船體重量帳」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Δdraft = ΔM/(rho A) for "Large-hull weight account", which value is closest to the simplified exercise for Large-hull weight account; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.?

steps.title: 大型船體重量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Large-hull weight account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大型船體重量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Large-hull weight account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Δdraft = ΔM/(rho A)；代入 M = 1612.5 tonne added mass、rho = 1025 kg/m³、A = 18000 m² waterplane area，得 0.0874 m（「大型船體重量帳」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 M 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Δdraft = ΔM/(rho A); with M = 1612.5 tonne added mass, rho = 1025 kg/m³, A = 18000 m² waterplane area the result is 0.0874 m (simplified exercise for Large-hull weight account; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise M by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：M 增加 10% 時，結果變為 0.0961 m（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising M by 10% changes the result to 0.0961 m (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 0.0874 m（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 M 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 0.0874 m (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in M with an engineering explanation.

Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

steps.title: 大型船體重量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Large-hull weight account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「大型船體重量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Large-hull weight account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「大型船體重量帳」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。把新增模組的假設質量代入吃水增量，與排水體積守恆交叉核對；再列出重量位置改變但總重量不變時本模型漏掉的效應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Large-hull weight account”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Calculate draft increment for a hypothetical added module, cross-check displaced-volume conservation, and identify effects omitted when weight position changes without changing total mass. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 024-01 標記，圖表須寫明「埃吉納深水油田：教學假設」。把吃水估算與重心、縱傾、自由液面三項限制分開呈現，模型不取代海事穩度審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 024-01 and mark charts “Egina deepwater field: teaching assumptions”. Present draft screening separately from centre of gravity, trim and free-surface constraints; the model does not replace marine stability review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「大型船體重量帳」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Large-hull weight account” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「大型船體重量帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Large-hull weight account" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 「大型船體重量帳」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
流速增加一成時，摩擦壓降也只增加一成。
optionsEn: An error at “Large-hull weight account” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A ten-percent velocity rise increases friction loss by only ten percent.

quiz.explanationEn: An error at “Large-hull weight account” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 大型船體重量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Large-hull weight account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大型船體重量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Large-hull weight account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「大型船體重量帳」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。重量清冊漏項會造成排水量預測偏低；液艙自由液面可降低穩度，即使平均吃水仍接近預測也不能忽略。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「埃吉納深水油田」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Large-hull weight account” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Missing items in the weight register underpredict displacement; free liquid surfaces can reduce stability even when mean draft remains close to prediction. Using outside rather than inside diameter changes velocity and friction estimates; forcing multiphase flow into a liquid-only equation hides slug-related peaks behind the mean value.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
